data_plan.source: https://data-api.binance.vision/api/v3/klines (free public Binance market data, no key)
data_plan.reason: Intraday 4h window not used in prior daily experiments; chronological split and walk-forward possible within one reproducible page.

criteria.promotion: only if OOS net > no-trade and walk-forward majority positive; no relaxation

hypotheses.theory: On intraday bars, a volatility expansion from a contraction regime marks the start of a directional move; entering after confirmation avoids the noise of calm ranges.
hypotheses.mechanism: Enter long when realized_vol(20) > 1.5x trailing 60-bar median AND previous 20-bar vol was <= median AND close > SMA(50); exit when vol falls below median or after 6 bars (24h). Liquidity proxy must be OK.
hypotheses.source_edge: volatility clustering and regime transition on continuous crypto market
hypotheses.bias_risks: regime lookback choice, 4h sampling, threshold sensitivity, no large grid
hypotheses.falsification: reject if OOS trades <2, OOS drawdown >25%, OOS net <= no-trade, or walk-forward not majority positive

hypotheses.theory: A volume surprise that coincides with a volatility regime shift confirms informed participation; static volume filters previously failed because they ignored the transition.
hypotheses.mechanism: Enter long when volume z-score(24) >= 2.0 AND realized_vol regime changes from LOW/NORMAL to HIGH within the last 3 bars AND close[i-1] > close[i-2]; exit when volume z <= 0 or after 6 bars. Liquidity proxy must be OK.
hypotheses.source_edge: informed volume participation at regime change
hypotheses.bias_risks: volume manipulation, threshold choice, correlated BTC/ETH moves, multiple testing if re-run
hypotheses.falsification: reject if OOS trades <2, OOS drawdown >25%, OOS net <= no-trade, or walk-forward not majority positive

deferred.reason: no reproducible free historical depth artifact
